blocks.text: It is meant to save Europe’s auto industry from China’s unfair trade practices. The European Union’s Industrial Accelerator Act (IAA), proposed in March, seeks to upgrade European car factories and only subsidize vehicles produced in Europe. Yet, the EU’s “Made in Europe” plan is causing deep concern among other allied carmaking nations — such as Turkey, Morocco, Japan and South Korea — all of them deeply embedded in European supply chains.
